verdict.rationale: HelixDB's own docs say queries can traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking, and that filtering works on both nodes and edges, so filtered vector search is a native capability. Filtering an exact candidate set implies recall is preserved, but nothing documents the latency impact of filtered vector queries. Missing for 10: documentation of supported structured metadata filter operators/conditions, latency or performance evidence for filtered vector search, explicit recall guarantees or benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking, so results cannot escape graph or permission boundaries.
Search and filtering on both nodes and edges, not just nodes.
